title: Case #2 — Circular polarization in the confusion limit
description: Blind Stokes V recovery of two faint circularly polarized sources in a confusion-limited SKA-Low field, inspired by V-LoTSS (Callingham et al. 2023). SKA-Low AA* (307 stations), 175 MHz, 50 MHz in 64 channels (781.25 kHz, limiting bandwidth smearing to <5% at the image edge at 20 arcsec), 2 h with 20 s integrations, station SEFD 4532 Jy. Background: T-RECS (Bonaldi et al. 2019) continuum population at 175 MHz down to 10 uJy within the imaged 1x1 deg field (60462 sources, Stokes V = 0). Two unresolved 80% circularly polarized sources: A with V = +8 sigma_V and B with V = -5 sigma_V, sigma_V = 25.6 uJy/beam (the 36.2 uJy/beam measured at 20 arcsec in a 1 h noise-only run, scaled by 1/sqrt(2)), each placed 8-12 arcsec from a 3-5 times brighter Stokes I source. Stokes I (multiscale) and V images at Briggs 0 with a 20 arcsec restoring beam (5 arcsec taper).
